summary: Tested the editable About/Contact pages and the author photo placeholder. Backend: 18/18 pytest passed. This covered the public GET (shape and defaults), unknown slug returning 404 on GET and admin PUT, PUT saving and persisting for both slugs, whitespace stripping, validation 422 (empty or blank title/body, http:// and javascript: URLs, URL with a space, title/eyebrow too long), member 403, anonymous 401 and member is_admin=false. Frontend: on /about, eyebrow, title and 3 paragraphs render, along with the dashed placeholder showing '[Placeholder: author photo]' and the CTA. /contact shows its text and the support email button. Admin dashboard shows the verses, about and contact links. Editing at /admin/pages/about: empty title or body shows an error toast and nothing is saved. A valid save shows the 'About Page updated' toast, and the change survives a reload. /about then shows the edited text and about-author-photo (the image loaded, naturalWidth 1700). Clearing the URL brings the placeholder back. Contact editing saves and shows on /contact; the contact editor has no photo field. An http:// URL is rejected by the server. Member sees no admin links and is redirected from /admin/pages/about to /dashboard. Footer About/Contact links work and all 6 social icons are present. Mobile layout is fine.

issues: Saving a non-https photo link shows the raw Pydantic message "String should match pattern '^(https://\S+)?$'" as the toast. Check the link on the client side, or show a friendly message such as 'Photo link must start with https://'.
A bad or broken photo link shows a broken-image preview. A broken link saved as photo_url would also show a broken image on /about, because there is no onError fallback to the placeholder.

action_items: (Minor) Replace the raw regex validation message for photo_url with a friendly one
(Minor) Add an img onError fallback to the placeholder in AuthorPhoto and in the admin preview
critical_code_review_comments: InfoPage.usePage and AdminPage both call api.get without error handling (AdminPage uses .catch(() => {})). If GET /pages/{slug} fails, the page shows the Loader forever. Add an error state.
DEFAULT_PAGES has no photo_url key. It works because of src.get(k, ''), but adding photo_url: '' would make the defaults explicit.
